get.summary: Liveness + dependency status (db, redis, keycloak). 503 when db or redis is down.
Strategy builder metadata (stub until goal 06). Trader, quant or admin only.

put.summary: Replace a user's roles (audited). Users with non-novice roles must enrol MFA at next login.

get.summary: List audit events (newest first). Non-privileged users see their own events.
Recompute the hash chain. Returns valid:false with the first broken id on tamper.
OIDC discovery (dev IdP subset)
Public signing keys of the dev IdP

post.summary: Create an account. Everyone starts as novice (PAPER); Pro trading needs the appropriateness assessment, then TOTP enrolment at the next login.
Password step. Returns ok, mfa_required or mfa_enrollment_required.
Start TOTP enrolment. Returns the otpauth URI and base32 secret.
Verify a TOTP code (completes enrolment on first use) and issue the session.

get.summary: Current user, roles, preferences and server-side capabilities

put.summary: Update view mode, theme, colour convention or hotkeys (audited)

get.summary: Instrument registry (SIMULATED seed). Precision, tick, qty step and sessions for every instrument.
One instrument with its venue and current session status.
Venues (ISO 10383 MIC; SIMULATED sample calendars) with current session status.
One venue with its calendar and current session status.
OHLCV candles, oldest first, registry precision. SIMULATED data.
Last quote per symbol (with stale flag) and the UTC day open.
Last L2 depth snapshot for a symbol.
Feed status (as published on the status channel) and gateway counters.
Economic calendar (SIMULATED provider; times and events are invented). Max 31 days.

post.summary: Stop a feed adapter (ops/chaos drill). Admin only, audited.
Start a stopped feed adapter (resyncs on the resulting gap). Admin only, audited.
Monte Carlo projection of a trading edge (costs included). SIMULATED. Audited.
Block-bootstrap projection of a trade list (backtest or paper). SIMULATED. Audited.

get.summary: Paper-account analytics (SIMULATED fixture fills until the goal 03 paper engine).

post.summary: "Project from my paper results": analytics, then a block bootstrap of the paper trades. Audited.

Order preview: notional, fees + spread, FX conversion, margin impact, loss if the stop is hit (currency and % of equity), reward:risk, confirmation flag and the pre-trade risk verdict. PAPER, SIMULATED.
Place a paper order. Idempotent on clientOrderId (201 new, 200 replay, 409 reused with a different body). Risk rejections return 422 with a machine code and a plain-language message.

get.summary: List orders (open by default), newest first.

delete.summary: Cancel every open order, optionally for one symbol (Pro terminal "Cancel all"; each cancel is audited).

get.summary: One order with its children (bracket stop/target, OCO legs).

patch.summary: Amend quantity, limit, stop or trailing distance of a working order (audited).

delete.summary: Cancel an open order (audited). Cancelling an OCO group cancels its legs.

get.summary: Paper account: cash, equity, day P&L, margin used/free, leverage, loss-limit usage, halt state (base currency, SIMULATED).

put.summary: Confirmation thresholds, tighter risk limits, and the base currency (only before any activity). Audited.

get.summary: Double-entry ledger lines (newest first) and balances per ledger account.
Open positions with mark (exit side), unrealised P&L, notional and margin in base currency.

post.summary: Close a position at market (reduce-only market order through the normal OMS path).

get.summary: Fills with quote at decision, fill price, slippage, fees and FX conversion (newest first).
Alerts (reconciliation mismatches). Risk officers and admins see all; others their own account.

post.summary: Run reconciliation now (engine positions vs ledger replay, cash vs ledger). Risk officers/admins: all accounts; others: own account.
Trigger the kill switch: robots | robots_cancel | robots_cancel_flatten. Idempotent, audited, REST fallback.

get.summary: Current halt state of your paper account.

post.summary: Resume trading after a halt (trader, quant, risk officer or admin; MFA). Risk officers/admins may pass accountId.

get.summary: The active appropriateness questionnaire (no answer key) and your status: eligible, passed, cool-down.

post.summary: Submit answers. Server-graded against the pass mark; a fail starts a cool-down; a pass grants the trader role and signs you out so the next login sets up two-factor authentication. Audited with version and score.

get.summary: Saved terminal layouts (names and JSON), most recently saved first.

put.summary: Save (create or replace) a named layout.

get.summary: The user’s watchlists (created with the Majors and Global defaults on first read).

post.summary: Create a watchlist (≤ 20 per user, ≤ 500 symbols each).

put.summary: Rename, reorder symbols (drag or add/remove) or move a watchlist.

get.summary: The user’s price and indicator alerts, newest first.

post.summary: Create a price (above/below) or RSI(14) alert on a timeframe. Audited as alert.created.

delete.summary: Cancel an active alert. Audited as alert.cancelled.

get.summary: Net exposure by currency, historical VaR(95 %, 1 day), correlation clusters and daily loss vs limit (PAPER, SIMULATED history).
